items.title: Predator and Prey
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Are you the predator or the prey? Take your pick and become a sly fox or a hopping rabbit!

- 10 skins included
- Run, rabbit, run! 
- By 57Digital

items.title: Bee Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
What's the buzz? Blend in with the hive and make sure the bees stay friendly with the Bee Teens skin pack, otherwise who knows what sour honey might come your way!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Magic Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
I've cast a spell on you! Can you guess what it is? A creeper doesn't stand a chance against you now! Show off some flashy lights and cast your way around the world with the Magic Teens skin pack!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Parkour Pros
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Hardcore parkour! Jump into the sky between each block and avoid the lava with some sick moves with the Parkour Pros skin pack! What better way to get the lead on a creeper than jumping from above? Be the number one player on the block!

- 10 skins (one free)
- By 57Digital

items.title: Dream Farm
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to wake up and smell the... cows? Sometimes all you want to do is settle down with a nice farm and some loud animals, and what better way to do it than with the Dream Farm skins! You don't want to get your nice skins dirty, after all...

- 10 skins (1 free)
- By 57Digital

items.title: Space Chimps
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Who was first on the moon? What if it wasn't humans...? Take some time to explore the stars and see the world from above with the Space Chimps skin pack, where the world isn't your oyster, but space is!

- 10 skins (1 free)
- By 57Digital

items.title: Stained Glass Mobs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time for a new, brighter take on the mobs. Why not see them as stained glass? Stare through the mobs and be blinded by the light with the Stained Glass skin pack!

- 10 skins (1 free)
- By 57Digital

items.title: Anime Demons
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to look down, far, far down. Dress up as an anime schoolkid but with a secret twist... they're demons! Spook your friends and take a walk on the wild side with the Anime Demons skin pack. Who says being bad doesn't pay?

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Traveling in Style
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Going on holiday? Going camping? Or maybe just taking a trip to the local mine to find some rare blocks? Well, it's time to go in style! Take your pick of the Travelling in Style skin pack and wow all your friends with how incredible you look!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Emoji Dreams
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Do emojis dream of electric smiles? Tuck yourself into your Minecraft bed and get comfortable with your favorite expression with the Emoji Dreams skin pack! Happy dreams are made of these, after all.

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Liquids
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to shake things up, and perhaps become a milkshake... Pick your favorite liquid and wear it with pride in the Liquids skin pack! Maybe you could even give your friends some water when they fall in lava?

- 10 skins
- No bucket available
- By 57Digital

items.title: 2 Bit Mobs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
1-bit, 2-bit... Wait, that's it? Pick your favorite mob and become their 2-bit counterpart, whether it's a cute cow or a spooky skeleton, they've never looked better than they have in the 2 Bit Mobs skin pack!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Glitchy Fashion
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
There's been a glitch in the world! Make a statement with the most fashionable skins in the Glitchy Fashion skin pack, where you can trick your friends into thinking you're glitching out!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Skeleton Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
What's that sound in the distance..? It sounds like bones rattling together! Take a peek into the afterlife with the Skeleton Teens skin pack, where you can play a tune with your ribs and fit in with the mobs!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Neon Robots
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Step into the future, the world of tomorrow, and a world of multicolored lights! With the Neon Robots skin pack, you can light up the world and be a helpful friend to whoever needs you!

- 6 HD skins included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Color Fill 2
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Do you like colors? Do you like gradients? Why not mix the two together! Pick some colors and have them gently mix together with the Color Fill 2 skin pack, where the aim is to be as mixed and colorful as you can be! Take your pick of your favorite mix.

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Western Emojis
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
How are you feeling today? Happy, angry, sad, playful? Take the chance to express how you're feeling to your friends with the Western Emojis skin pack - with faces like these, everyone will know how you're feeling after dying in the middle of a mine!

- 10 skins
- :D :( :@ :P
- By 57Digital

items.title: Cave Explorers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Grab your head torch, your jacket, and your comfy boots - it's time to become a Cave Explorer! Let's find out what treasures lay beneath the earth and what lurks in the darkness, just make sure that you're coming prepared..!

- 10 skins
- Loot not included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Magic
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to cast a spell over your friends with these magical skins! Pick a side and enjoy some supernatural roleplay.

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Safest House Ever
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Are you tired of those pesky monsters? Or perhaps, getting blown up by those creepers?
Fear no more! In the safest house ever, you have ultimate defenses in your disposal!

- Custom made turrets!
- Luxurious base to explore!
- Live in comfort!

And much more!

items.title: Millionaire Tropical Vacation
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Travel to your dream's vacation getaway! Explore the endless outdoor activities or relax in your own private gazebo!

- 3 Millionaire supercars!
- Luxurious and majestic tropical island!
- Private outdoor activities!
- Tropical vacation getaway!

And much more!

items.title: Teen Celebrities
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Brand new celebrities have joined the game. They have amazing teen fashioned looks and outfits. Choose your best match in style and dive into the game as a teen spirit icon.

+ Fashion
+ Trendy
+ Celebrity
+ By In Mine

items.title: Potion Ocean 100 Days
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
100 day challenge! However, the oceans have been turned into a gigantic cauldron of potion! The rain is also potion! This won't be easy, but at least you can get unlimited potions from the ocean now!

- 4 sketchy designed skins!
- Fill random unlimited potions from any water source!
- Random effects applied if you're in water or rain!
- Survive 100 days!
- By Piki Studios

items.title: Skyblock 100 Days
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
100 day challenge! Perfect for streaming or vlogs. Each day you survive you will be rewarded with a new skyblock.

- Normal speed days (20 mins)
- Fast speed days (10 mins)
- Hyper speed days (5 mins)

- 4 amazing skins
- 90 unique small skyblocks
- 10 unique mega skyblocks
- Survive 100 days!
